facts.text: Ajman Saray is set along a private beach in Ajman.
facts.excerpt: set along a private beach in Ajman

facts.text: The resort's white sandy beach has an unobstructed view of the Arabian Gulf and is a place to watch Ajman's sunset.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy our white sandy beach with unobstructed view of the Arabian Gulf; it's a perfect place to witness Ajman's captivating sunset.

facts.text: Ajman Saray describes itself as the first beachside Luxury Collection Resort in the Middle East.
facts.excerpt: Ajman Saray, is the first beachside Luxury Collection Resort in the Middle East

facts.text: The rooms and suites have private balconies with Arabian Gulf or creek views.
facts.excerpt: Our Ajman hotel rooms feature private balconies with romantic Arabian Gulf and creek views.

facts.text: The Royal Suite looks over the Arabian Gulf and its beaches from both its living room and its balcony.
facts.excerpt: Take in an unrivaled view of the Arabian Gulf and its pristine beaches from the living room and the balcony of the Royal Suite.

facts.text: Bathrooms have walk-in showers, bathtubs and Byredo amenities.
facts.excerpt: Refresh in spacious bathrooms with walk-in showers, bathtubs, and luxury Byredo amenities.

facts.text: Every room has Signature Luxury Collection linens.
facts.excerpt: Sleep well in plush beds with Signature Luxury Collection linens in every room.

facts.text: Zihn Spa offers treatments including a hammam experience, with a sauna and steam room.
facts.excerpt: Rejuvenate at Zihn Spa, where bespoke treatments, a hammam experience, tranquil sauna, and soothing steam room offer a relaxing escape.

facts.text: Zihn Spa's menu has seven signature healing journeys built around an energy-balancing concept.
facts.excerpt: Our extensive menu serves seven signature healing journeys

facts.text: The resort has two swimming pools, one for children, steps from the beach.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel boasts two swimming pools, one specifically for children, that are mere steps from the beach.

facts.text: The Kids Club has a kids pool, a playground, games and toys.
facts.excerpt: Our Kids Club is a great escape for children, boasting a range of activities like the kids pool, a playground and other games and toys.

facts.text: The resort holds a falcon show on the beach celebrating falconry in Arab tradition.
facts.excerpt: discover the UAE’s national bird, a symbol of force and courage, recognizing the importance of falconry in Arab tradition and culture.

facts.text: Bab Al Bahr is a beachside bar and grill with Mediterranean-inspired dishes, handcrafted drinks and DJ music.
facts.excerpt: Bab Al Bahr is a vibrant Ajman bar and beachside spot with coastal chic vibes, Mediterranean-inspired dishes, handcrafted drinks and live DJ beats.

facts.text: Bab Al Bahr has a rooftop Sunset Lounge.
facts.excerpt: This à la carte Beach Bar & Grill exudes modern, easy-going charm with a Sunset Lounge at the rooftop.

facts.text: Escape Equestrian Bar is a quiet bar styled like an elegant members' club, serving signature cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Like an elegant members' club, this quiet Ajman bar is a stylish spot for signature cocktails by our expert bartender, light bites, and indulgent desserts.

facts.text: The resort hosts beach weddings at an outdoor event space by the Arabian Gulf.
facts.excerpt: Host your wedding or reception at our outdoor event space, steps from the waters of the Arabian Gulf.

facts.text: Self parking and valet parking are complimentary.
facts.excerpt: Self parking is complimentary for guests. Valet parking is complimentary for guests.

facts.text: The resort holds Green Key certification.
facts.excerpt: The Green Key Certified

facts.text: Sharjah International Airport is the closest airport.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near Ajman Saray, a Luxury Collection Resort, Ajman is Sharjah International Airport (SHJ).

facts.text: The fitness center has TechnoGym equipment and is open around the clock.
facts.excerpt: accessible 24 hours a day for our resort guests

facts.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
facts.excerpt: No, rooms at Ajman Saray, a Luxury Collection Resort, Ajman do not have a fridge.

facts.text: Ajman Museum, nearby, is housed in an 18th-century fort that was the ruler's residence until 1970.
facts.excerpt: The 18th-century fort served as the ruler’s residence until 1970, before it was converted into a museum a decade later.
